SELECT 'ACTIVITY' AS type, activity.activity_id AS source_id, activity.subject AS title, activity.result_summary AS content, activity.status, COALESCE(activity.complete_time, activity.start_time) AS event_time, activity.owner_name, activity.dept_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_activity_participant participant WHERE participant.activity_id = activity.activity_id AND participant.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND participant.deleted = 0 AND participant.participant_type = 'USER' AND participant.participant_ref_id = #{userId}) THEN #{userId} ELSE activity.owner_id END AS owner_id FROM crm_activity activity WHERE activity.customer_id = #{customerId} AND activity.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND activity.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'FOLLOW_UP', follow_up.follow_up_id, follow_up.follow_up_type, follow_up.content, NULL, follow_up.follow_up_time, follow_up.owner_name, customer.dept_id, customer.owner_id FROM crm_follow_up follow_up INNER JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = follow_up.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE follow_up.customer_id = #{customerId} AND follow_up.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND follow_up.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'OPPORTUNITY', opportunity_id, opportunity_name, stage, status, COALESCE(stage_changed_time, create_time), owner_name, dept_id, owner_id FROM crm_opportunity WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'QUOTE', quote.quote_id, quote.quote_name, quote.remark, quote.status, quote.create_time, quote.owner_name, customer.dept_id, customer.owner_id FROM crm_quote quote INNER JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = quote.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE quote.customer_id = #{customerId} AND quote.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND quote.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'RECEIVABLE', receivable.receivable_id, receivable.receivable_no, receivable.remark, receivable.status, COALESCE(CAST(receivable.received_date AS DATETIME), receivable.create_time), receivable.owner_name, customer.dept_id, customer.owner_id FROM crm_receivable receivable INNER JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = receivable.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE receivable.customer_id = #{customerId} AND receivable.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND receivable.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'TICKET', ticket.ticket_id, ticket.ticket_title, ticket.solution, ticket.status, COALESCE(ticket.resolved_time, ticket.opened_time), ticket.owner_name, customer.dept_id, customer.owner_id FROM crm_service_ticket ticket INNER JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = ticket.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE ticket.customer_id = #{customerId} AND ticket.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'EMAIL', email.email_id, email.subject, email.content_summary, email.send_status, COALESCE(email.send_time, email.create_time), email.create_by, customer.dept_id, customer.owner_id
WHERE email.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND email.customer_id = #{customerId} AND AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user account JOIN sys_tenant tenant_entry ON tenant_entry.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND tenant_entry.deleted = 0 AND tenant_entry.status = '0' JOIN sys_user_role membership ON membership.user_id = account.user_id AND membership.tenant_id = account.tenant_id JOIN sys_role role_entry ON role_entry.role_id = membership.role_id AND role_entry.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND role_entry.deleted = 0 AND role_entry.status = '0' JOIN sys_role_menu grant_entry ON grant_entry.role_id = role_entry.role_id AND grant_entry.tenant_id = account.tenant_id JOIN sys_menu menu_entry ON menu_entry.menu_id = grant_entry.menu_id AND menu_entry.status = '0' AND menu_entry.perms = 'crm:email:list' WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.user_id = #{userId} AND account.status = '0' AND account.deleted = 0 AND (tenant_entry.expire_time IS NULL OR tenant_entry.expire_time > NOW())) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role membership JOIN sys_role role_entry ON role_entry.role_id = membership.role_id AND role_entry.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND role_entry.deleted = 0 AND role_entry.status = '0' JOIN sys_role_menu grant_entry ON grant_entry.role_id = role_entry.role_id AND grant_entry.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id JOIN sys_menu menu_entry ON menu_entry.menu_id = grant_entry.menu_id AND menu_entry.status = '0' AND menu_entry.perms = CASE email.biz_type WHEN 'CUSTOMER' THEN 'crm:customer:list' WHEN 'OPPORTUNITY' THEN 'crm:opportunity:list' WHEN 'QUOTE' THEN 'crm:quote:list' WHEN 'TICKET' THEN 'crm:ticket:list' END WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.user_id = #{userId})
